summary.text: Joe Perry is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Joe Perry advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
Ballotpedia's campaign finance table lists a 2022 candidacy for Rockingham 5 that ended in a general election loss.
